test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 06 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is a feature of Self-Help group?

options.text: The group takes care of the debt recovery.
There is a requirement of collateral.
These groups are classified as commercial banks.
The interest rates are generally high.

solution:
The correct answer is the group takes care of the debt recovery.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The debt recovery is handled through the self-help organisation.**
 
• In the **area of employment and income-generating activities,** they work to increase the functional ability of the **underprivileged and marginalised groups in society.**
 
• They provide** collateral-free loans **to groups of people who typically struggle to obtain loans from banks.
 
• Also, they use group leadership and conversations to resolve disputes.
 
• They are a **crucial supplier of microfinance services **to the underprivileged.
 
• They serve as a conduit for official banking services to the underprivileged, particularly in rural areas.
 
• Also, they **urge the impoverished to develop a saving habit.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Self-Help Group** 

 
 
• The** Self-Employed Women's Association was founded in 1970**, marking the beginning of **SHG in India (SEWA).**
 
• The** SHG Bank Linkage Programme of NABARD, **which began in 1992, has expanded to become the largest microfinance programme in the world.
 
• Since 1993, **SHGs **have been able to open savings accounts with the **RBI and NABARD. The SHG-Bank **link programme was made possible thanks to this initiative, which also strengthened the **SHG movement.**
 
• **The Swarn Jayanti Gram Swarozgar Yojana (SGSY)**, launched by the Indian government in 1999, aims to encourage rural** SHG development and skill-based self-employment.**
 
• The programme was expanded into a statewide movement in 2011, leading to the creation of the **National Rural Livelihoods Mission (NRLM),** the greatest poverty reduction initiative in the history of the planet.
